title: Generator effectiveness (induction quality) on the iGPU: PARTIAL -- Qwen3.5-9B measured, Qwen3.6-27B wedged the iGPU HIP server, Gemma-4-31B not reached.
methodology_note: Each arm's own llama-server on the iGPU (HIP, -fit off, Q4, mtp=False uniform), launched+scored+stopped sequentially. Per (arm,game): build_progress_window + LIVE prop.induce + WorldModelVerifier heldout_accuracy & cell_recall. Object-perception OFF -> isolates the generator. Quality only; speed ignored. Qwen3.5-9B completed both games (mean heldout 0.0). Qwen3.6-27B WEDGED the iGPU HIP server (see per_arm.qwen27b.note) after ~59min on its first induction; the run was killed. Gemma-4-31B never launched. PARTIAL artifact: only real measured numbers recorded; no fabrication.

per_arm.note: WEDGED: iGPU HIP llama-server (port 8932) accepted the tu93 /completion request but never generated -- /slots reported is_processing:False while the process spun at 196% CPU and pinned the iGPU at 100% for ~59min; the client (benchmark) hung in poll() on the ESTABLISHED socket 39902->8932; tu93 world_model.py was never rewritten. iGPU dropped 100%->2% the instant the wedged server PID was killed, confirming it was spinning, not generating. This is the known iGPU-HIP big-model serving failure mode (/health 200 but /completion hangs), NOT slowness. No numbers fabricated.
NOT RUN: benchmark terminated after the 27B arm wedged, before the gemma-4-31B arm launched.

ranking_note: Only qwen9b produced a real number (mean heldout 0.0); this is NOT a valid 3-way ranking. For the bigger-generator quality comparison the authoritative evidence remains exp5598 (dense-27B heldout 0.525 >> 9B 0.100 > 35B-MoE 0.391) on a working substrate; this iGPU run only re-confirms the 9B inducer floors (heldout 0.0 on 2 games).
replicates_exp5598_27b_gt_9b: partial: the 9B-floor half replicates (9B mean heldout 0.0 here vs 0.100 in exp5598); the 27B>9B half is UNMEASURED here (27B wedged).
